location_lifecycle.label: Campus & Room Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a campus, building, or classroom. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The campus, building, or classroom is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The campus, building, or classroom is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The campus, building, or classroom is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the campus, building, or classroom are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the campus, building, or classroom.
